root_cause_hypothesis: HARD BLOCKER, no grounded path: an AxDataEntityView cannot be given ANY X++ through the tool surface, so the two central deliverables of the case - the public boolean validateWrite() override and the DMF staging hook public static void postGetStagingData(DMFDefinitionGroupExecution) - were never written. Two independent defects combine. (1) WRITE PATH: createD365File.ts dispatches case data-entity to generateAxDataEntityXml(objectName, properties) and silently DROPS the sourceCode argument (same bug class as the table path already fixed at createD365File.ts:793). The shared builder dataEntityXml.ts buildAxDataEntityXml takes only (entityName, properties) and emits no SourceCode element at all. (2) REPAIR PATH: d365fo_file(action=modify, objectType=data-entity, operation=add-method) is rejected with -Operation add-method on object type data-entity is not supported by the bridge- : data-entity IS in the modify tool objectType enum (modifyD365File.ts:937) and in its advertised description, but is ABSENT from BRIDGE_MODIFY_TYPES (bridgeAdapter.ts:1210), so EVERY modify op on a data entity dead-ends. The tool advertises a capability it does not have; the only remaining route is hand-edited XML or overwrite=true, which the loop forbids. This is the same AxDataEntityView writer gap first recorded in 2026-07-27T14__L2-virtual-entity-power-platform, escalated from cosmetic to CASE-FATAL, because DMF entity behaviour lives in exactly that SourceCode block. THIRD DEFECT (build-breaking): buildAxDataEntityXml hard-codes DataManagementStagingTable to entityName+Staging whenever dataManagementEnabled=true, and an empty override falls back to that same default, so the caller cannot opt out. xppc DOES validate it: the FULL build failed with -Metadata Error: AxDataEntityView/ConDemoImportTargetEntity/DataManagementStagingTable: Table ConDemoImportTargetEntityStaging does not exist.- (negative test satisfied, the property is load-bearing). CRITICAL COROLLARY: the INCREMENTAL build of the very same XML reported Errors: 0 / Build succeeded twice - the Metadata Validation phase runs ONLY on fullBuild:true, so an incremental green build is a FALSE GREEN for every metadata-level reference error and must not be accepted as a case verdict. FOURTH DEFECT (false-clean BP): run_bp_check WITHOUT targetFilter returned -BP Check passed- with no processed-element line and zero findings, while the same model with a targetFilter returned 9 warnings and, before the privilege was added, a BP ERROR DataEntitySecurityPrivilegeCheck. Everything the tools CAN write was correct: the bridge table writer produced standard-shaped AxTable XML (AlternateKey=Yes, correct AxTableFieldEnum typing for DMFTransferStatus and NoYes), the entity round-tripped through IMetadataProvider losing nothing it did emit, and the full build is green with 0 BP errors. No Descriptor package had to be added: the entire DMF surface this case needs (DMFDefinitionGroupExecution, DMFEntity, DMFDefinitionGroupName, DMFExecutionId, DMFIsSelected, DMFTransferStatus) lives in ApplicationFoundation, which the Contoso sandbox already references.
